description:
Step 1: Agent reads experiment_results.json and analysis_config.json. It recognizes that with 3 metrics total (1 primary + 2 secondary), Bonferroni correction requires alpha=0.05/3≈0.01667. It implements analyze_experiment() from SKILL.md (two-proportion z-test with pooled SE) for each metric at the corrected alpha. It checks sample ratio mismatch for each segment: |n_control - n_expected| / n_expected > 0.01 — the diabetic_patients segment has |3800-4025|/4025≈0.056, which must be flagged. Results including corrected_alpha, lift, p_value, ci_95, significant, and srm flags are saved to experiment_analysis.json.

Step 2: Agent reads patient_cohort.csv and modeling_spec.json. It calls add_time_features() from SKILL.md on enrollment_date, producing dow_sin, dow_cos, month_sin, month_cos, is_weekend columns. It excludes pharmacy_id (high-cardinality, >50 levels — per SKILL.md checklist). It builds a ColumnTransformer using build_feature_pipeline() with numeric_cols and categorical_cols as specified, fitting ONLY on training data. It trains an XGBoost classifier and calls evaluate_model() with StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5), computing roc_auc and avg_prec with mean/std and overfit_gap for each metric. Results including cv_folds=5, stratified=True, roc_auc (mean/std/overfit_gap), avg_prec (mean/std/overfit_gap) are saved to model_evaluation_report.json.
